evals.name: fires-on-tooling-audit
evals.prompt: Audit the scripts, CLIs and hooks in this repo and tell me what is duplicated or stale.
evals.expected_output: The skill inventories the repository's scripts, command-line tools and hooks and reports findings with file references, without editing anything.
expectations: The response inventories scripts, command-line tools and hooks in the repository
The response makes no edit to any file and offers fixes only as proposals awaiting a yes

evals.name: stays-quiet-on-unrelated-request
evals.prompt: Write a function that parses an ISO 8601 date string and returns the weekday name.
evals.expected_output: The audit-tools skill does not run; the request is ordinary code writing, not a tooling audit.
expectations: The response writes the requested function
The response does not inventory the repository's scripts, hooks or tools
